user.title: Set up TV guide
user.description: Loads programme data in XMLTV format once a day (gzip supported). The main source provides the times; from the fallback source only channels missing in the main source are read, e.g. regional channels. Choose the channels afterwards under “Configure”.

data_description.url: Address of the XMLTV file; default epgshare01 (about 4 MB, correct times, no regional channels)
data_description.url_ersatz: Only for channels missing in the main source; if the main source fails, everything comes from here. Empty = none. Default iptv-epg.org (about 45 MB, only loaded when needed)

error.ungueltige_adresse: The address must start with http:// or https://.

init.title: Sources and channels
init.description: Only the selected channels are stored and queried. The list contains the channels of both sources and fills after the first load.

data_description.url: Address of the XMLTV file; default epgshare01 (about 4 MB, correct times, no regional channels)
data_description.url_ersatz: Only for channels missing in the main source; if the main source fails, everything comes from here. Empty = none. Default iptv-epg.org (about 45 MB, only loaded when needed)

error.ungueltige_adresse: The address must start with http:// or https://.

abfragen.name: Query guide
abfragen.description: What is on now or at a given time (current and next show per channel), or when a show airs (search).

zeitpunkt.name: Time
zeitpunkt.description: Time (20:15) or date and time (2026-10-26T20:15); empty = now.

sender.name: Channels
sender.description: Only these channels; empty = all selected.

suche.name: Search
suche.description: Title or part of it; returns the next airings.
